faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Patna Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Counsellor post at IIT Patna is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the institute before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Psychology, along with PG Diploma or Certificate courses in General Psychology or Counselling to be eligible for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Counsellor position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Patna Counsellor job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Counsellor role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by a walk-in interview for the eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this IIT Patna Counsellor recruitment is IITP/SA/2026-27/02.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Technology Patna.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Patna located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Patna is located in Patna, Bihar, with the pincode 801106.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification is for IIT Patna, located in Bihar. Candidates from all states are generally eligible to apply for government jobs unless specific domicile restrictions are mentioned in the official notification.
